items.catalogueText: Vietnam city maps 1:12,500 Vinh and Bé̂n Thu̓y, Vietnam. / prepared under the direction of the Department of Defense and published by the U.S. Tophographic Command. Author: United States. Army Map Service. Publisher: Washington, D.C. : U.S. Army Topographic Command 1970 ; [Bethesda, Md.] : Reprinted by National Imagery and Mapping Agency, 2000. Edition 3-TPC. Scale 1:12,500; transverse Mercator projection. 1 map : color ; 42 x 59 cm. 'Compiled in 1970.' Standard map series designation: Series L909 'NSN 7643014027971 Ed. No. 03'. 'NIMA Ref. No.: L909XVINBENT'. Call number G8024.V6C2 1970 .A7M3. Catalogue record 9955651283506421 (OCLC 1340190240).
items.note: Princeton catalogue assertion, checked 2026-10-06: Edition 3-TPC; published 1970 by U.S. Army Topographic Command; reprinted by NIMA 2000 (the scan is of the Princeton copy, whose printing date the catalogue gives as both). NIMA ref L909XVINBENT. Digitised in Figgy (IIIF, PDF). Printing identity and collar details remain unreviewed.

unverified.reason: nla.gov.au, catalogue.nla.gov.au and trove.nla.gov.au sit behind a proof-of-work bot challenge and the Trove v2 API is gone (410). A web-search snippet of the record says: 'Vietnam city maps / prepared and published by the Defense Mapping Agency, Topographic Center', created in Washington from 1964, 4 items, and 'only 3 editions of the Saigon / Ho Chi Minh City sheet have been digitized as of February 2022'. Editions, years and the series statement were not seen. Not written.

Further L909 items at Texas Tech could not be found: the search UI is image-captcha gated, and after about 700 sequential item-page requests the host began answering every request with the same captcha (error 338), so crawling was stopped. None of the eight leads given (635107, 623847, 635169, 718507, 608733, 718544, 635282, 652196) is L909: they are L7014 (635107 Ho Chi Minh City 5-DMA; 608733 Long My), L9011 Vientiane (623847), L8020 Pictomaps (718507, 718544, 635282), L607 (652196) and a Hammond map (635169). Other leads seen only in search results, not opened: digital_objects 609067 (titled 'Da Nang (Tourane)'), 609208, 635075, 650379. Virtual Saigon (virtual-saigon.net) records TTU item MAP12090115 'Sài Gòn' 1968 1:15,000, 'Saigon Series L909', Vietnamese, Vietnam Archive Map Collection; the TTU record itself was not opened.

Princeton also catalogues Đà Lạt, Ed. 1-A.M.S. (FE), 1964 (NIMA reprint 2001), Series L909, record 9955640823506421, Lewis Library Map Collection. It is a print holding: no electronic access in the catalogue and no Figgy record. Not an online holding; not written.
